name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti
memory_bandwidth_basis: DERIVED, not quoted: NVIDIA product page prints 8 GB GDDR6 and a 256-bit interface but not the bandwidth. 14 Gbps x 256-bit / 8 = 448 GB/s, the FE rate. Flagged derived so it is not read as a quoted figure.
notes: Founders Edition: 4864 CUDA cores, boost 1.67 GHz, 8 GB GDDR6, 200 W. 8 GB holds a 7B Q4 only. A later GDDR6X 3060 Ti SKU exists; this record is the GDDR6 FE the product page describes, and the Vulkan row does not say which it measured.
